items.description: Beanvest is an investment portfolio tracking application. It allows you to keep track of all your investments in one place with helpful insights.
A map mashup of World Cup Soccer 2010 Venues along with a StreetView look at the venues.

MeetWays lets you find a point of interest between two given addresses. For example, to meet a friend for lunch you can enter his and your addresses, type of restaurant and get the exact halfway point and a list of nearby restaurants.

Google and NORAD, the North American Aerospace Defense Command, have partnered to let you track Santa and his travels from the North Pole using Google Maps and Google Earth. The Santa Tracker goes live at 6am EST on December 24th.
Trentter is live Twitter trend monitor which provides a highly customizable user interface to visitors.
Full-featured mobile Twitter site that runs on every phone. Enables posts longer that 140 characters and presents replies as conversations.
Nice integration of library data like what you have checked-out or are waiting forinto an automatically updating Google Gadget. Initially for Ann Arbor District Library. Talis mashup contest winner.
A BBC News Data visualization demo using PHP + HTML5 + CSS3 + jQuery.
Just Remind It is an iPhone application to send call-based voice reminders to yourself, friends, colleagues and clients. Send automatic reminders and get your tasks done.

The Inside Big Data Mashup processes and filters high volumes of data from a variety of sources in the web. The mashup identifies data sources, such as news and blogs, in addition to summarizing the breakdown of metadata associated to the sources. This way, users can access important descriptive data such as dates, visitor counts, and comments attributable to particular sources of data.
RealWebStats is the best Real Web Stats and Website Valuation service for webmasters and website owners.
